integrity: The exact census, target-eight impossibility search, symmetry orbit, and Fano extension are replayed from a standalone standard-library verifier embedded with this record.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification restricted to the noiseless Boolean-OR model with six tests and at most two defectives.
No generalization to larger test numbers or higher defective-set bounds is claimed.
Historical originality remains subject to the possibility of an unindexed equality classification.
title: Rigidity of the six-test seven-item at-most-two separable design
